reference_sql:
SELECT ol.order_line_id, pr.promo_code
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = ol.promo_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17'
alternatives: SELECT ol.order_line_id, pr.promo_code FROM promotions pr JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = pr.promo_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-16'

SELECT ol.order_line_id, pr.promo_code FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = ol.promo_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17' AND pr.promo_id IS NOT NULL

other_way.sql: SELECT ol.order_line_id, pr.promo_code FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = ol.promo_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17' AND pr.promo_id IS NOT NULL
other_way.tradeoff: A LEFT JOIN with IS NOT NULL keeps the same lines, but an inner join already drops the lines with no match.
